Not your head. Not your heart. Look lower.

Kevin Trudeau says there is an emotional guidance system in the solar plexus. He says it's the first thing to learn if you want luck.

His instruction is simple: be conscious of it, stay aware, and tune in to what you actually feel at any given moment.

What feeling is loudest in you right now?
